children: Aurobindo Pharma share price will remain in focus on August 31 following the company received three observations from United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA).

The United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) inspected Unit-VI, an API manufacturing facility of Apitoria Pharma, a wholly owned subsidiary of the company, situated at Anakapalli District, Andhra Pradesh from August 24 to August 28, 2026.
The inspection concluded with three observations, which are procedural in nature, and we will respond to the US FDA within the stipulated timeline, company said.
Catch all the market action on our live blog

Last week, the company received four observations, which are procedural in nature, after USFDA conducted a routine inspection at Lannett Company LLC, a wholly owned step-down subsidiary of the company, located at Seymour, IN, USA from 17th to 21st August 2026.
Also, its arm AuroPeptides, a manufacturer of Peptide APIs, located at Telangana received one observation from USFDA relating to facility and equipment maintenance.

title: Aurobindo Pharma shares in focus on three observations from USFDA
